title: Semiprime GCD Tare Sqrt-Multiplicity and the BBLR Logarithmic Angle Pinch
description:
We prove that the Schur complement tare on semiprime GCD matrices transforms the arithmetic multiplicity scaling from the classical 2/3 exponent down to the critical 1/2 boundary. Under the Baez-Duarte / Balazard / Landreau / Saias (BBLR) logarithmic decay envelope E_{dir}(N) ≤ C_{BBLR} / ln(N) with C_{BBLR} ≈ 0.212694, the higher-dimensional Schur correlation angle satisfies sin(Θ_N) ≤ √{C_{BBLR} / ln N}. This forces the half-angle parameter t_N = tan(Θ_N / 2) to contract at rate O(1 / √{ln N}), pinching the critical strip. We formalize the iterated sqrt-multiplicity bridge and the BBLR Schur angle pinch in Lean 4 with zero custom axioms.
